name: rsi_connors_pullback_v46
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, micro-corrections within an intraday trend create extreme RSI(2) readings at 5-second resolution. When RSI(2) drops below 20 while the index remains above its 10-minute SMA, two consecutive sell-dominated 5-second bars have absorbed nearby resting buy orders, briefly exhausting immediate demand. Market makers and VWAP-benchmarked algos recognise this as a deviation from the prevailing flow and begin stepping in, snapping the index back within 30-60 seconds as the order book rebalances. The RSI(2) extreme marks local selling exhaustion, not trend reversal — the 10-minute SMA confirms the macro direction remains intact.
core_signal_oneliner: Ultra-short 2-bar RSI drops below 20 within a 10-min SMA uptrend, marking 10-second selling exhaustion before order-book rebalancing resumes
